label: prop:frobenius-positivity-filter
title: Frobenius positivity filter for even-$A$ decays
html:
Proposition. For even A: a channel configuration is Frobenius-positive if and only if both parent and daughter yield non-negative Markov traces.

A configuration is excluded exactly when its sign-pattern has odd total parity. Of the 2^A sign-patterns, exactly half are excluded.
heading: Proposition
